summary: Extended the frontend Team Builder app for round 1 with optional-header parsing, six ranked candidate combinations, clickable candidate-detail UI, updated automated coverage, and refreshed README/FINAL_OUTPUT handoff docs.
completed_work: Updated `src/lib/parseClipboard.js` to accept header-present or headerless TSV input, only recognize the exact canonical Korean header row, and preserve correct row numbers in both modes.

Refactored `src/lib/optimizer.js` to compute richer candidate objects, rank distinct combinations by total score difference -> role-score-difference sum -> tank difference -> unranked difference, and randomize only exact metric ties through injected RNG.

Updated `src/lib/appFlow.js`, `src/main.js`, `src/lib/render.js`, `src/constants/copy.js`, and `src/styles.css` so the app shows six Korean candidate cards, default-selects the first candidate, and swaps only the detailed team board when another candidate is clicked.

Expanded tests in `test/parseClipboard.test.js`, `test/optimizer.test.js`, `test/appFlow.test.js`, and `test/responsiveLayout.test.js`, and aligned `scripts/browserSmoke.mjs` plus `testing/fakeDom.js` with the new candidate UI.
Rewrote `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` to document the optional-header rule, six-candidate ranking behavior, actual verification scope, and the remaining non-blocking browser evidence gap.

verification.result: Passed. Parser, optimizer, main-entry DOM flow, responsive CSS, and browser smoke helper tests all succeeded.
Passed. Static bundle rebuilt successfully in `dist/`.

verification.command: for name in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable microsoft-edge microsoft-edge-stable; do command -v "$name" || true; done
verification.result: No Chromium-family browser binary was found in this sandbox, so `npm run test:browser` was skipped.

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { buildBalanceFromClipboard } from './src/lib/appFlow.js'; const sample = await readFile('./src/fixtures/samplePlayers.tsv', 'utf8'); const headerless = sample.split('\n').slice(1).join('\n'); for (const [label, text] of [['header', sample], ['headerless', headerless]]) { const balance = buildBalanceFromClipboard(text, { rng: () => 0.5 }); console.log(label, balance.players.length, balance.candidates.length, balance.candidateCount, balance.result.scoreDifference, balance.result.roleScoreDifferenceSum, balance.result.tankScoreDifference, balance.result.unrankedDifference, balance.result.teams.map((team) => team.totalScore).join('/')); }"
verification.result: Confirmed both header and headerless sample input paths produce 10 parsed players, 6 visible candidates, 113400 evaluated combinations, and a selected candidate with `scoreDifference=0`, `roleScoreDifferenceSum=0`, `tankScoreDifference=0`, `unrankedDifference=0`, `teamTotals=14/14`.

known_gaps: `npm run test:browser` could not be executed here because no Chromium-family browser is installed in the sandbox.
The browser smoke harness validates built JS/CSS through a temporary HTML shell; it does not literally open `dist/index.html`.
handoff_notes: This round intentionally prioritized candidate-combination expansion over closing the older real-browser/mobile QA gap, which remains non-blocking per the current spec.
QA should run `npm run test:browser -- --browser=/path/to/chromium` in a browser-equipped environment if real engine evidence is needed for release.
`dist/` has been rebuilt and now reflects the candidate-feature changes.
